$comment: Everything studio-specific lives here. Edit this file, then `npm run configure` (dev/build/deploy run it for you). Nothing in src/, src-tauri/, worker/ or tools/ needs touching to rebrand the launcher. Secrets never go in this file.

server.$commentStats: Download counts (README 'Download stats'). Paste the D1 database id here to switch counting on; leave empty to count nothing.

legal.$comment: Links for the first-run 'I am 18+ and accept' screen and Settings. Bump termsVersion when the EULA/privacy policy changes and every player is asked again. The installer's licence page uses src-tauri/EULA.txt (keep it in step with the EULA PDF).
